hero.title: Your Future Deserves Every Opportunity.
hero.subtitle: Discover scholarships that match your dreams. Explore financial assistance, understand your eligibility and take the next step towards your education with GRANTLY.
hero.trustedBadge: Connecting students across India and globally to official opportunities

landing.problemText: Finding scholarships, understanding eligibility, gathering documents and tracking applications can be confusing and overwhelming. Many deserving students miss out simply because information is fragmented across dozens of disconnected websites.
landing.solutionText: GRANTLY brings authentic, verified opportunities together with a transparent eligibility engine, automated document checklists, and an AI assistant that guides you from discovery to portal submission.
landing.visionText: Our vision is to make educational opportunities accessible by simplifying the journey towards financial assistance for every deserving student.
landing.missionText: Our mission is to empower students through personalized scholarship discovery, transparent eligibility guidance, accessible information and simplified application assistance.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Four Simple Steps to Your Scholarship
landing.step1Desc: Share your academic level, grades, residency, and preferences in our secure onboarding.
landing.step2Desc: Browse curated, verified opportunities with transparent source provenance and live deadlines.
landing.step3Desc: Instantly see whether you qualify, why, and what specific documents or criteria are required.
landing.step4Desc: Follow our guided preparation checklist, link out to official portals, and track every application.
landing.feature1Desc: Algorithmic matching comparing your academic profile, domicile, and financial criteria against authentic eligibility rules.
landing.feature2Desc: Ask questions about requirements, criteria explanations, and required paperwork grounded in official scholarship sources.
landing.feature3Desc: Never wonder why you do or don't qualify. We break down each requirement into explicit verified checks.
landing.feature4Desc: Step-by-step document checklist and guidance before you proceed to the official provider portal.
landing.feature5Desc: Every scholarship includes official provider links, last verification timestamps, and official gazette citations.
landing.feature6Desc: Stay informed with timely deadline notifications, policy updates, and university admission releases.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Fund Your Educational Journey?
landing.ctaText: Join thousands of school, undergraduate, and postgraduate scholars discovering real opportunities today.

footer.desc: GRANTLY is an educational scholarship discovery and application assistance platform. We empower students with verified data, transparent eligibility, and guided preparation.
footer.disclaimer: GRANTLY is an independent information discovery platform and does not represent official government bodies or award scholarship funds directly. All applications are submitted through respective official portals.
